uncited: *   **Cloning Over-densification:** The clone operation (creating a new Gaussian at the same position) can cause catastrophic over-densification and inflated counts without quality improvement.
*   **Occlusion Bias:** Normalizing by raw view count $M$ (as in standard 3DGS) includes occluded views where the gradient is zero, dragging down the average and stalling densification.
*   **Footprint Bias:** Using the per-view total weight $\sum_p w_{i,p}$ as the normalizer reintroduces pixel-count dependence, as larger footprints accumulate more weight.
